name: itinovo-crm
description: Work on itinovo, the CRM for travel agencies, tour operators and DMCs, by talking to Claude: turn a client's request into a draft quote, follow up the quotes waiting for an answer, load suppliers' price lists and confirmations, set up groups and events, turn old offers into templates, review the week's departures and prepare their documents, review the agency's numbers, record a client's emails on the booking and enter a period's invoices and payments into the accounting software.
